title: Art 200 — aged industrial color families
color_space: sRGB hex; convert to scene-linear for untextured Blender BSDF colors
direction: Muted, sun-faded pigment with coherent per-model color stories. No neon, saturated primary colors, bright white panels, rainbow patchwork or blanket orange rust. Exposed steel, mineral dust and restrained rust support the painted areas. Preserve functional low-intensity status lights.
surface_notes: Favor broad calm color fields with localized seam rust and edge wear.
Different collections must visibly use at least eight paint families; colors are not separate counted models.
Material images must be portable to GLB. Geometry needs supported details and eased manufactured edges.
Fictional advertising uses original brands and wording; no copied Fallout brands, mascots or logos.
